changelog: Say "spell Christine as C-H-R-I-S-T-I-N-E" — or "কামালের বানান K A M A L লিখো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and that word is re-spelled letter by letter wherever it sits in the message. Gboard's Pixel 8+ "Spell [word] as [letters]" command, now on this keyboard in English and Bengali — the fix for a name dictated with the wrong spelling.
